items.title: How Chewy's CEO plans to lower the $2,000 vet ER bill
items.summary: Chewy CEO Sumit Singh explains to Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi how the company is trying to bring pet insurance to millions of US households after finding fewer than 2% of pets were covered.

items.title: Crypto Stocks Sink on Bitcoin's Slide; Aramark Falls on Earnings | Stock Movers
items.summary:
On this episode of Stock Movers:

- Bitcoin's slide is bringing down crypto stocks including Strategy (MSTR), Coinbase (COIN) and Circle (CRCL) with investors increasingly turning away from the asset class.
- Aramark (ARMK) shares are dropping after the food and related products distributor reported adjusted earnings per share and revenue for the fourth quarter that missed the consensus estimates. 2027 guidance includes a slight miss on EPS growth. The midpoint of the organic revenue growth projection is also below the Street estimate. 
- Blackstone Digital (BXDC) shares are jumping after it agreed to a deal to buy a majority stake in Amazon's data center portfolio.

items.title: AST SpaceMobile Sinks 8% as ULA’s Vulcan Rocket Failure Rattles Space Stocks
items.summary: Key TakeawaysAST SpaceMobile fell 8% today after a Vulcan rocket failure destroyed 40 of Amazon’s Leo satellites. No AST satellites were aboard, but the loss tightens a launch market AST depends on.
